text.description_html:
Brass Accents Decorative Apollo Push Plate 3-5/8" Wide x 18" High

This decorative push plate is from the Brass Accents Renaissance Collection. Highly detailed solid cast brass styled in Italian Renaissance, popular around the turn of last century.

Brass Accents provides distinctive craftsmanship with old-world tradition for a lifetime of elegance, hand finished in the USA. They are one of the worlds leading crafters of decorative hot-forged and cast brass door hardware.

Also available: Matching Decorative Apollo Pull Plate

Specifications for Brass Accents A04-P5230 Decorative Apollo Push Plate

  • Plate Width: 3-5/8"
  • Plate Height: 18"
  • Material: Cast Brass
  • Finish Warranty: 10 Years

Comes complete with matching finish mounting screws for easy installation.
